source_priority.rule: Use genuinely verified historical cost information for the applicable symbol/time/execution context when available.

Otherwise use a documented conservative envelope/scenario frozen before the candidate economic outcome. The bound must be applicable to the candidate context and chosen so it cannot make a failing system falsely pass.
If neither verified history nor a defensible conservative bound exists, or reasonable cost uncertainty can change economic sign, classify COST_UNRESOLVED.

conservative_envelope_rules: Envelope values and evidence source must be frozen before opening the affected candidate outcome.
Use the adverse credible side of uncertain costs for promotion decisions; favorable assumptions may not create a survivor.
A single current spread snapshot must not be projected across history as VERIFIED historical truth.
Current broker observations may support only an explicitly scoped conservative bound when defensible; they do not become historical paths.
Positive swap or financing benefit may be credited only when historically VERIFIED for the applicable periods; otherwise screening must not rely on that benefit.
Unknown slippage/delay may remain UNRESOLVED rather than blocking M4.

current_known_reusable_history.note: M4 freezes policy only and does not invent missing historical costs.
